name: Brand Story
summary: Passive brand-narrative profile composed from canonical Image with Text with an optional editorial signature.

anatomy.name: rootProfile
anatomy.description: Brand Story context hook layered on the required canonical Image with Text section and named by its visible contextual heading.

anatomy.name: media
anatomy.description: Required canonical Image with Text media region containing target-owned native media.

anatomy.name: content
anatomy.description: Required canonical Image with Text narrative grouping.

anatomy.name: eyebrow
anatomy.description: Optional canonical contextual label that never replaces the required title.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Required non-empty visible contextual heading whose id names the section.

anatomy.name: body
anatomy.description: Required non-empty target-owned narrative rich content using canonical Image with Text anatomy.

anatomy.name: signature
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned section-footer attribution or editorial mark without authenticity semantics.

anatomy.name: signatureImage
anatomy.description: Optional signature image whose informative or decorative alternative remains target-owned.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Fixed contextual profile of the canonical default Image with Text presentation.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: One intrinsic size whose crop, split, measure, padding curve, threshold and signature cap remain private composition.

states.name: default
states.description: Complete passive brand narrative with required media, visible title and rich body plus accepted optional content.

behavior.name: imageTextComposition
behavior.description: Brand Story consumes canonical Image with Text anatomy, source order, intrinsic response, media containment, typography, color and spacing without recreating them.

behavior.name: namedSection
behavior.description: The required visible contextual heading names the native thematic section through a target-unique id.

behavior.name: requiredComposition
behavior.description: Targets omit the complete profile when media, trimmed visible title or non-empty narrative body is unavailable.

behavior.name: mediaSemantics
behavior.description: Targets own media source, intrinsic dimensions, responsive candidates, loading, focal point and informative or decorative alternative purpose.

behavior.name: narrativeOrder
behavior.description: Media remains before narrative in DOM and reading order while the canonical component adapts to available inline size.

behavior.name: signatureSemantics
behavior.description: A supplied signature is ordinary visible footer content or target-owned media. It does not assert verified authorship, authenticity or cryptographic proof, and visible text receives no redundant replacement label.

behavior.name: contentResilience
behavior.description: Short, long, empty, localized, RTL and unbroken content remains contained without viewport- or Studio-owned S8 layout rules.

behavior.name: passiveRuntime
behavior.description: Brand Story owns no controlled or uncontrolled state, listener, observer, request, timer, layout read, focus model, live region, animation, custom element, asset or neutral runtime.

properties.name: media
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the entire profile when target-owned native media is unavailable.
properties.description: Required target-owned native media consumed through canonical Image with Text anatomy.

properties.name: eyebrow
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the eyebrow without leaving empty rhythm.
properties.description: Optional short context above the required heading.

properties.name: title
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the entire profile when the trimmed visible heading is empty.
properties.description: Required non-empty visible contextual heading; targets choose the native heading rank.

properties.name: body
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the entire profile when narrative rich content is empty.
properties.description: Required non-empty target-owned narrative rich content; targets own sanitization and native markup.

properties.name: signature
properties.unsetBehavior: Omit the footer completely when no attribution or editorial mark is supplied.
properties.description: Optional target-owned text or media footer without authenticity or verification semantics.

accessibility: Require native media, a non-empty visible contextual heading and non-empty narrative body; omit invalid compositions.
Associate the native thematic section with the visible title through one target-unique aria-labelledby and id pair.
Give informative media useful alternatives and intrinsic dimensions; use an empty alternative for decorative or redundant imagery.
Preserve media-before-narrative DOM order and semantic rich-content structure at every width and in RTL.
Render a supplied signature as ordinary visible footer text or purpose-labelled target media without redundant aria-label or authenticity claims.
Add no focus stop, widget role, key handling, selection, live region, authored motion or neutral runtime.

web.notes: Implemented as a named passive profile of canonical Image with Text with strict required composition and an optional editorial footer.

shopify.notes: Localized merchant section reuses the shared Image with Text Liquid composition and adds optional target-owned text or image signature content.
